chunk-001:c007.proposition: Free discourse must outrank particular dogmas because open speech is the governing process by which dogmatic and totalitarian errors are corrected.

chunk-001:c009.proposition: Chimpanzee territorial violence shows that group atrocity predates religious doctrine, so its deepest causes lie in evolved tribal aggression rather than surface beliefs alone.

chunk-002:chunk-002-candidate-01.proposition: Biblical sentences must be interpreted within the Bible's overarching developmental narrative rather than treated as isolated, self-sufficient moral commands.

chunk-002:chunk-002-candidate-04.proposition: Revelation can be read psychologically as teaching that truthful speech produces redemption when personal and social worlds collapse.

chunk-002:chunk-002-candidate-07.proposition: Facts cannot yield values without an a priori interpretive framework, and that mediating framework is partly best understood as personality or story.

chunk-002:chunk-002-candidate-09.proposition: Stories can function as a priori moral intuitions, and the contrast between maximal misery and flourishing already relies on constructed narrative poles resembling hell and heaven.

chunk-003:c003-06.proposition: God can be understood as the trans-temporal reality expressed through truth, evolved value structures, conscience, sacrifice, judgment, and selection toward competent moral hierarchy.

chunk-003:c003-08.proposition: Penitent reflection that sincerely asks how to repair wrongdoing functions as answered prayer because an unwelcome corrective answer can emerge from the process.

chunk-004:chunk-004-candidate-02.proposition: Local moral differences can coexist with deep universals, just as diverse languages and stories share structures that identify their common form.

chunk-004:chunk-004-candidate-08.proposition: Discarding the religious edifice risks losing genuine wisdom because Enlightenment rationality arose through a long developmental history that purely rational accounts understate.
